caseNameFull: Phillip TIBBS v. Kimberly BUNNELL, Judge, Circuit Court of Kentucky, Fayette County

opinions.text: Motion of American Hospital Association, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of The Joint Commission for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Alliance for Quality Improvement and Patient Safety for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Kentucky denied.
